use_case: Clinical decision support (sepsis prediction) model: scores adult ED and inpatient encounters every 15 minutes and alerts the assigned nurse when the score crosses a threshold, prompting the sepsis screen
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor's predictive decision support intervention (machine learning model supplied with the certified EHR)
source_evidence: EV-055 (EHR upgrade notes; live since 2025-11-03; no review record); EV-043 (EHR vendor SOC 2)
data_categories: Vital signs; laboratory results; nursing assessments; medications; date of birth (age) (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Nurse performs the sepsis screen and calls the provider; the ED physician or hospitalist decides on treatment; the alert orders nothing
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (input variable age); 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11) (developer duties; source attributes; HTI-5 proposal would remove some); HIPAA (EHR vendor BAA); FDA device status is the vendor's determination (FD&C Act sec. 520(o)(1)(E) and FDA CDS guidance); hospital QAPI program (42 CFR 482.21)
status: In production since 2025-11-03; continue with conditions

use_case: Imaging triage: FDA-cleared software flags suspected large vessel occlusion and intracranial hemorrhage on head CT and moves flagged studies up the reading worklist
vendor_or_model: PACS-integrated software from an imaging AI manufacturer (FDA-cleared device)
source_evidence: EV-055 (PACS configuration; in production since 2025-03); EV-071 (model version log)
data_categories: Head CT images and DICOM metadata including age (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: A radiologist reads every study; the flag changes reading order, not whether a study is read; stroke team activation stays a clinical decision
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (age used to exclude patients under 18); FDA labeling and 21 CFR 803.30 (user facility reporting); HIPAA
status: In production since 2025-03; continue with conditions

use_case: Ambient AI scribe pilot: records ED encounters and drafts the note for physician review
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (generative speech-to-text and large language model; model hosting carved out)
source_evidence: EV-040 (pilot from 2026-05); EV-041 (vendor standard BAA); EV-055 (12 ED physicians); EV-058 (consent practice)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if diagnosis or order suggestions are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Physician reviews, edits, and signs every note with an attestation; no automatic filing
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 934.03 all-party consent; HIPAA (vendor is a business associate; BAA amendment pending); 45 CFR 92.210 only if clinical suggestion features are enabled
status: Pilot (12 ED physicians since 2026-05); expansion paused until conditions are met

use_case: EHR rule-based clinical decision support: 186 active rules (drug interaction, weight-based dosing, renal dosing using eGFR, screening reminders, nursing early warning score)
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor rules engine (rule-based) and LIS eGFR calculation (non-AI)
data_categories: Age; sex; weight; medications; vital signs; laboratory values (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacists, nurses, and providers accept or override each alert; no automatic orders
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (non-automated tools are in scope under 45 CFR 92.4; inputs include age and sex; 1 legacy rule used race); HIPAA
status: In production; 92.210(b) review completed 2026-08-25; 1 rule retired

use_case: Coding assistance: suggests diagnosis and procedure codes and evaluation and management levels for ED and outpatient encounters
vendor_or_model: Coding assistance vendor (natural language processing and machine learning; model hosting carved out)
source_evidence: EV-040 (in use from 2026-01); EV-041 (BAA with a no-training clause); EV-055 (14 coders)
human_in_the_loop: Certified coders accept, change, or reject every suggestion before the claim is released
applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA with no-training clause); Medicare overpayment reporting and return (42 CFR 401.305); payer billing rules
status: In production since 2026-01; continue with conditions

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters, summaries, and policies (found in web proxy logs: 214 users in July 2026)
vendor_or_model: Various public generative AI services (no contract)
source_evidence: EV-055 (department heads survey); EV-070 (web proxy review: 214 users in July 2026)
